beats.what: Introduction: sparse solo lines scroll across piano-roll score
Repeated chord blocks, then dense layered textures
Fast busy bursts with blue bass hits
Calmer long horizontal lines, slow rounds
Massive full-orchestra bars, then quiet interlude
Rival rhythmic patterns, dense purple procession
Frenzied climax with golden bass floor

notes: Continuous scrolling graphical score, no cuts or text until credits; beat boundaries guessed from texture changes at 13 s step.
